'''Kor Hestilic''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA Kor Hestilic" /> located within the [[Kor Hestilic system/Legends|Kor Hestilic system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and was part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kor Besadii system/Legends|Kor Besadii]], [[Kor Nijiladii system/Legends|Kor Nijiladii]], [[Kor Vosadii system/Legends|Kor Vosadii]], [[Mulatan system/Legends|Mulatan]] and [[Nar Chunna system/Legends|Nar Chunna systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kor Hestilic was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Hestilic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Hestilic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Hestilic was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the world in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
